attchmntText: Vikram Solar Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Vikram Solar Reports Q2 & H1 FY27 results, EBITDA per watt improves by 37% QoQ, Strengthens Business Mix and Order Inflow, 9 GW Cell Facility on Track to Produce First Cell in December 2026."
voiceSummary: Vikram Solar Limited filed a press release regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations increased 17.7% from H1FY26 to H1FY27. Absolute EBITDA per watt improved by 37% sequentially. The company added approximately 1.7 GW of new orders during the quarter. Net debt to equity stood at 0.17x as of September 30, 2026. The 9 GW N-type TOPCon cell facility is scheduled to produce its first cells in December 2026. VSL PowerHive plans to inaugurate a 7.5 GWh BESS assembly plant in January 2027. India Ratings rated the company's long-term bank facilities at IND A+/Stable.

attchmntText: Please find enclosed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Vikram Solar Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by India Ratings & Research Private Limited. The report confirms no deviation from IPO proceeds utilization objects. The company utilized INR 35.19 Mn for a guest house, considered project cost. Total IPO proceeds were INR 15,000.00 Million. Utilized amount stands at INR 13,230.89 Million, leaving INR 1,769.11 Million unutilized. The monitoring agency noted delays in deployment and implementation schedules. Government approvals are partly obtained. Unutilized funds are invested in fixed deposits with Canara Bank and State Bank of India. The report was submitted on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Vikram Solar Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vikram Solar Limited approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. Revenue from operations was Rs. 10,732.67 million for the quarter and Rs. 26,092.97 million for the six months. Profit for the period was Rs. 37.30 million for the quarter and Rs. 224.57 million for the six months. Earnings per share were Rs. 0.10 for the quarter and Rs. 0.61 for the six months. The auditor, GARV & Associates, issued a review report noting a safeguard duty receivable of Rs. 1,485.20 million and trade receivables of Rs. 527.90 million withheld by customers. Total assets stood at Rs. 58,621.32 million as of September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Vikram Solar Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Vikram Solar Limited has intimated the schedule for an analyst and institutional investor meeting under SEBI regulations. The company officials will attend the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference on Tuesday, 17th November 2026, starting at 9.00 a.m. The meeting will be conducted in person and will include group and one-on-one interactions. The company notes that dates are subject to change due to exigencies. Discussions will be based solely on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be discussed during these interactions. This intimation is filed for the information and records of the stock exchanges.

attchmntText: Vikram Solar Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Vikram Solar Limited has announced an earnings conference call to discuss financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST. Participants include Mr. Sameer Nagpal, Chief Executive Officer, Mr. Ranjan Jindal, Chief Financial Officer, Mr. Arun Mittal, Chief Executive Officer of VSL PowerHive Private Limited, and Ms. Rinal Shah, General Manager of Corporate Finance. The event is hosted by EY LLP. Investors are requested to pre-register via the provided Diamond Pass link to avoid wait times. Dial-in numbers are available for international and domestic participants. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies.
